pool.text: Suleiman ibn Qutulmish annexed Adana during his military campaign.
Kizzuwatna ruled Adana under the protection of the Hittites according to inscriptions.
Mamluks left the administration of the Adana plain to Yüreğir Turks.
Selim I incorporated the emirate into the growing Ottoman Empire.
The Ottomans terminated the Ramadanid administration after the Celali rebellions.
İbrahim Paşa demolished Adana Castle and the city walls.
Adana Municipality was officially incorporated in the city.
The governor of Adana built Turkey's tallest clock tower.
The completion of the Seyhan Dam brought explosive growth to the city.
The Adana State Theatre opened its doors at the Sabancı Cultural Centre.
Metropolitan Municipality Law split municipal governance in the city.
A major earthquake struck the city center and Ceyhan district.
The International Sabancı Theatre Festival began holding annual events.
Karaisalı was officially annexed to the city of Adana.
The fifth festival took place with an opening concert by the orchestra.
Unemployment in the city reached a record percentage.
Karataş Municipal Council agreed to amalgamate with Adana.
The carnival parade attracted a record-breaking number of people.
Adana was affected by a major magnitude earthquake in Southern Turkey.
Adana retained multiple companies in Turkey's top industrial rankings.
